text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm really sorry if I'm mistaken, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Was it you who delivered the flowers to my 
room this morning, Believe-san?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I noticed the knock and opened the 
door, I could only catch a glimpse of 
their back walking away, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I want to thank them 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! âWait, why for me?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Since you helped me out with advice 
before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... You said it was difficult to 
express your feelings, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
In that case, what if we used the language 
of flowers...? —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why you got baby's breath! Fufu, 
thank you. I truly appreciate the thought!
